Trusted AI Safety Expert (TAISE) Certificate
The global benchmark for safe, secure, and responsible AI adoption.
Enroll in TAISE
Home
Education
TAISE
The Trusted AI Safety Expert (TAISE) certificate, developed by the Cloud Security Alliance (CSA) and
Northeastern University, equips professionals to lead the safe,
secure, and responsible development and deployment of AI systems.
The industry-leading credential covers the full AI lifecycle from
generative AI fundamentals and architecture to governance, risk
management, privacy, and cloud security. Through a 10-module course
and final exam, you'll gain the frameworks, tools, and practices
needed to navigate regulatory requirements, protect against emerging
threats, and build organizational trust in AI.
Free Prep KitTraining Options
Winner of the Best Professional Certification Program 2026
Winner of the SC Award for Best Professional Certification Program 2026,
CSA's Trusted AI Safety Expert (TAISE) credential equips professionals
with the skills to securely develop, deploy, and govern generative AI
systems.
TAISE combines academic rigor with real-world application. Designed for
today's rapidly evolving AI landscape, it prepares professionals to
interpret global frameworks, mitigate risk, and lead responsible AI
adoption.
Why This Certificate Stands Apart
In a crowded market of AI courses, the Trusted AI Safety Expert
(TAISE) certificate delivers real-world impact.
Proven Leadership
With more than 16 years of cybersecurity thought leadership,
CSA has established programs like the AI Safety Initiative and
global standards like the STAR Registry, trusted by governments,
enterprises, and auditors worldwide.
Academic Excellence
Developed in partnership with Northeastern University's Institute for Experiential AI and its EDGE team, TAISE blends cutting-edge research with industry-facing
online learning.
Backed by CSA and Northeastern, TAISE is more than a
training – it's the standard for trusted AI safety
education.
What are the benefits of earning the TAISE Certificate?
Career Advancement
Showcase an industry-leading credential that validates
your ability to ensure the safe, secure, and
responsible development and deployment of AI systems.
In-Demand Skills
Build practical expertise across the AI lifecycle, and
learn to work with industry frameworks (CSA's AICM,
NIST AI RMF, ISO, MITRE ATLAS, and more).
Recognized Credential
Earn a digital badge and certificate co-issued by CSA and Northeastern to
showcase on LinkedIn, resumes, and professional profiles.
Trusted Partnership

standards, and Northeastern University's Institute for
Experiential AI, TAISE blends academic rigor with
real-world application.

Here's what to expect from the TAISE exam:
60 multiple-choice questions (6 per module)
120 minute time limit
80% passing score required
2 exam attempts included with purchase (valid for 2 years)
*No prerequisites are required for the TAISE exam. A basic
familiarity with AI, cloud, and security concepts is recommended.
For foundational knowledge, explore CSA's Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK).

Who should earn the TAISE certificate?
The TAISE certificate is designed for professionals who carry
responsibility for advancing safe, secure, and responsible AI
within their organizations.
Leading AI adoption: Driving organizational AI strategies, bridging knowledge
gaps across teams, and aligning AI initiatives with
business value, ethics, and compliance needs.
Building governance frameworks: Developing and enforcing standards for ethical AI use,
managing multi-jurisdictional regulations, and designing
documentation to reduce legal and reputational risk.
Safeguarding data privacy: Applying minimization, anonymization, and governance
practices across the AI lifecycle to meet GDPR, CCPA, and
global privacy standards.
Managing AI risks: Identifying and mitigating AI-specific threats,
applying frameworks such as NIST AI RMF and MITRE ATLAS,
and establishing ongoing monitoring.
Implementing technical security: Securing MLOps pipelines, applying Zero Trust principles,
and strengthening incident response across AI and cloud
environments.
If your responsibilities involve AI adoption, governance,
compliance, risk, or technical security, TAISE gives you
the frameworks, skills, and credentials to back your leadership.

Trusted Voices on TAISESee why leaders in security, risk, and compliance trust TAISE
as the standard for AI safety.
I am honored to have been one of the volunteers reviewing the training content and materials for TAISE. The program offers comprehensive coverage, not only on Model Governance, Risk Management, and Compliance, but also on AI Security and Threat Analysis, AI Risk Assessment, and the responsible use of AI. I highly recommend this course to security professionals seeking to enhance or validate their expertise in AI security.
Henry Hon
Senior Lead Security Professional, Lumen Technologies
The Trusted AI Safety Expert certificate is an accessible but comprehensive companion to anyone seeking to design, build, deploy and securely manage trusted, responsible AI systems. I particularly like the applied learning via case studies and technical deep dives which brings to life the many facets of AI safety and security.
April Baracho
Director, Enterprise Security Architecture, Citi
With 20 years of experience in the technology and consulting industry, I’ve seen countless programs come and go—but the Trusted AI Safety Expert Program truly stands out. The program is thoughtfully structured, with expert-led content that challenges even seasoned professionals to think differently. It’s a must for anyone serious about shaping the future of AI responsibly.
Daniel Lai
Strategy Advisory Director, Electrum Cloud
Reviewing the TAISE content gave me a rare opportunity to step back and reflect on how our field is evolving. As someone focused on IAM and cloud security, I found the curriculum surprisingly grounded in practical concerns especially for those working on integrating AI into secure-by-design systems. TAISE doesn’t just teach safety principles; it helps professionals across disciplines speak the same language when it comes to trustworthy AI.
It’s the kind of foundation I’d recommend to any security professional who wants to stay relevant as AI reshapes how we think about trust, risk, and responsibility.
Nattapong Tiwaporncharoenchai
Senior IAM & Cloud Security Architect, Airbus Protect
I am extremely pleased with the body of knowledge covered in the TAISE course. With the rapid adoption of AI, it is essential to bring security professionals up to speed in these technologies. TAISE helps separate the noise from the substance to make sure no time is wasted, and those responsible for securing enterprises hit the ground running and understand the risk that their organizations can be exposed to. One of my favorite aspects is the analysis of different case studies to help bridge the gap between theory and practice securing AI-enabled solutions.
Roger Ofarril
Information Security Manager, Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago
Having studied across many areas of IT and cybersecurity over the years, I can honestly say the CSA TAISE certificate stands out as one of the most relevant and valuable programs in today’s world.
It bridges a critical gap in our industry, ensuring that AI systems are developed, deployed, and governed with the same rigor we’ve long applied to cloud and network security.
What makes it exceptional is how it distills complex AI and data governance principles into clear, actionable practices that can be applied directly in real-world enterprise environments.
As someone who’s worked with the Cloud Security Alliance on the Zero Trust Working Group, it’s always exciting to see how CSA continues to lead the way in defining best practices for emerging technologies.
The TAISE program reflects that same spirit of collaboration and innovation, empowering professionals to embed responsible, Zero Trust-aligned principles into every stage of AI adoption.
This isn’t just training; it’s a roadmap for building trust in AI and securing the future responsibly, transparently, and effectively.
Jaye Tillson
Director of Strategy at Axis Security
AI is rapidly becoming a core service in every organization and a critical asset that must be secured. What makes the TAISE training unique is how it bridges the gap between high-level principles and practical implementation. It provided me with a clear framework to understand emerging threats, align with global standards, and apply security-by-design throughout the AI lifecycle. For professionals who want to adopt AI responsibly and with confidence, TAISE is an invaluable resource.
Moshe Ferber
Chairman at Cloud Security Alliance, Israel
